name: r01-requests-hash-empty-at-prague
note: EIP-7685 compute_requests_hash([]) == sha256(b'') and the field is emitted at Prague even when the block produced no requests. The pre-state carries the EIP-7002 and EIP-7251 predeploys with the runtime code those EIPs publish, so the two end-of-block system calls run against empty queues and contribute no request element -- the block is valid and its request list is empty. (Without that code eip-7002.md and eip-7251.md require the block to be marked invalid, which is a different assertion than this probe makes.)
